faq.title: 🟡 Any questions?
faq.text: Have a question that isn't answered here? You can contact us at

0.q: How to create my first song or image?
0.a: Sign up, choose a category (music or image), enter a text prompt, click "Generate" — and get the result in seconds.

1.q: How many generations are available in my plan?
a: Free — 1 generation per day for 7 days
Pro, Premium, Enterprise — extended limits and discounts

2.a: If you see an error or strange result, just try again — generations are only deducted on success. If the problem persists, contact support.

3.a: After registration, you’ll immediately get 5 free generations without linking a card. Want full 7-day trial access? Simply link your bank card — this helps us prevent spam. Everything is secure: no charges will be made without your confirmation.

4.q: How to pay for a subscription?

5.q: How does the referral program work?
5.a: Invite friends using your referral link and get bonus generations. +5 free generations for each active user.

6.q: How to change or cancel my plan?
6.a: Go to your account, select a plan and click "Switch". You can cancel anytime — access stays until the end of the paid period.
